summary: Fix correctly copies xy/xytext arrays before storing in Annotation, resolving mutable-reference bug from the report with minimal, correct scope.

issues.description: Resulting line exceeds project's typical line-length convention (~79 cols) and crams a ternary inline, slightly hurting readability/PEP8 compliance.
Inline conditional np.copy(xytext) if xytext is not None else None could be simplified to a small helper or pre-computed variable for clarity.
